svg.aria-label: A hyperplot latency chart, p50, p95 and p99 over five minutes with an SLO line at 250 ms, written out between the opening and closing tags of the div that fetches it: hx-get /charts/latency, hx-trigger every 2s and htmx:plot:resize, hx-swap innerMorph, hx-plot:autosize.
svg.title: hyperplot: live charts your server draws as SVG
